summary: Step into a quirky case, crack riddles, and uncover the truth.
description:
Solve mysteries and escape in this story-driven detective puzzle adventure game.

Step into the role of a detective solving unusual cases in a strange and mysterious world. What begins as a simple investigation quickly turns into a deeper mystery filled with hidden clues, unexpected twists, and challenging puzzles.

DETECTIVE ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Experience a unique blend of detective story and escape room gameplay. Explore 15 hand-crafted levels filled with secrets, interactive puzzles, and hidden objects to uncover.

SOLVE PUZZLES AND FIND CLUES
Use your logic and observation skills to solve brain-teasing puzzles, crack codes, and uncover hidden clues. Each challenge brings you closer to solving the case.

ENGAGING STORY-DRIVEN EXPERIENCE
Follow a compelling mystery where every interaction matters. Meet over 20 unique characters, each playing a role in the unfolding story.

EXPLORE AND DISCOVER
Interact with the world through point-and-click gameplay, explore detailed environments, and uncover secrets hidden in every level.

TRY FOR FREE
Play the first levels for free and unlock the full adventure to continue the story.

FEATURES:
- Detective puzzle adventure game
- Escape room style puzzles and challenges
- 15 hand-crafted levels to explore
- Hidden objects, clues, and brain teasers
- Story-driven mystery with unique characters
- Interactive point-and-click gameplay

If you enjoy puzzle games, escape room games, detective games, and mystery adventures, this game is perfect for you.
